Sold!

Rare opportinity to get a Guide in great condition with intact red pointer and GMT bezel.
I am selling this Enicar Sherpa Guide with its typical 43mm stainless steel two crown compressor case AND its rare funky bracelet. Watch is in unserviced condition but everything works as it should.

4 years ago I bought a sad Enicar Sherpa Guide from @skin_diver_lover with redial and other issues. With no parts in sight, I put it in my parts drawer. After almost four years I finally found a matching MK1 dial and completed the project. Patience allways pays out in the end! Now I have a nice MK1 Guide from 1961 with a bright dial. Definitely a keeper for the collection.

First Edition Enicar Jet Graph from around 1964. To my knowledge the first watch that used the Valjoux 724 GMT movement and by that, the first real GMT chronograph watch that was produced in greater numbers.

First series Jet Graphs came with metallic (soleil) dials in blue, grey and white.

The shown watch was sold in a British military store in Camp Terendak, todays Malaysia.

Havn't shown one of these nice Jet Graphs in a long time, despite being one of my Favs :)
This is an early example with paddle hands and thin GMT indicator. 
The Jet Graph was the first watch that used the Valjoux 72 GMT Chrono movement in 1963.

Just lately one of the pre series watches appeared, will write about it soon. Stay tuned!
